dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical linear narrowing of the 2D body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Predominantly smooth lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical indentation on the posterior-left edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate dark-grey median intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse clusters of darker grey pixels concentrated in the mid-dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between localized darker pigmentation and the primary slate-grey baseline.
